nodes.label: setup composite action
nodes.rationale: Shared test-job setup so every browser test group installs Bun, deps, Chromium and builds the frozen production bundles the same way

nodes.label: animations-group matrix job
nodes.rationale: Animation groups run one worker at a time since they sample animation frames

nodes.label: changes job (change detection)
nodes.rationale: Skips jobs a change cannot affect (docs, graphify-out, .scratch, LICENSE affect nothing; tests/domain does not affect browser suite); GitHub counts if-skipped jobs as passing; on detection failure everything runs

nodes.label: ci workflow
nodes.rationale: Runs on every change so required checks always report; browser tests split into named time-balanced groups so a red job names the area that broke

nodes.label: core-group matrix job
nodes.rationale: Core groups (pages, flows, editing, data, components) run projects in parallel with 2 workers

nodes.label: Graph health warnings and refresh failure reporting
nodes.norm_label: graph health warnings and refresh failure reporting

nodes.label: Browser test ledger
nodes.rationale: Fails if a browser test file is missing from CI groups or listed twice

nodes.label: Ruleset required checks (core, animations, checks, domain)
nodes.norm_label: ruleset required checks (core, animations, checks, domain)

nodes.label: Animations tier (tests/animations)
nodes.rationale: Frame-sampling tests run one at a time against frozen production bundles to avoid dev reloads changing source mid-sample.

nodes.label: Behaviour ledger
nodes.rationale: component-inventory.ts plus core/ledger.e2e.ts; every mapped test ID must resolve to exactly one test; fails if a browser test file is missing from or duplicated across ci.yml groups, or a tag is unknown.

nodes.label: Core tier (tests/core)
nodes.rationale: Mandatory functional tests run in parallel; must never import support/motion.

nodes.label: Frame samplers (support/motion.ts)
nodes.rationale: Native rAF frames needed to measure rendered entrances, so Playwright clock is not used; only Date is pinned

nodes.label: Graph local-only rule (caches, machine paths, HTML stay local; not in public/ or app routes)
nodes.norm_label: graph local-only rule (caches, machine paths, html stay local; not in public/ or app routes)

nodes.label: Graph refresh rule (refresh after every code/test/config change, before commit or completion)
nodes.norm_label: graph refresh rule (refresh after every code/test/config change, before commit or completion)

nodes.label: Branch naming (ai/ prefix, rename never fork)
nodes.norm_label: branch naming (ai/ prefix, rename never fork)

nodes.label: Pull request rules
nodes.rationale: PR numbers are permanent so open only after user approval; approval belongs to humans

nodes.label: Your lines only staging
nodes.rationale: Other agents edit the working tree in parallel, so stage only this thread's hunks

nodes.label: Playwright blob report merge
nodes.rationale: Group jobs upload blob reports; gate jobs merge them into one HTML report artifact

nodes.label: CI time-balanced groups
nodes.rationale: Named by area so a red job says what broke; balanced by run time so no job holds up the rest; rebalance when one group runs clearly longer. Whole run took 6.5 minutes on 25 October 2026.

nodes.label: Grouped tests (one seed, several steps)
nodes.rationale: Trade per-case isolation for wall-clock time; destructive paths and held-IDB races stay standalone.

nodes.label: Monthly Budget amount
nodes.rationale: Precedence: month's own Override one month, then latest Override default at or before it, otherwise no amount; Default rule unavailable when no earlier Override default exists.

nodes.label: Amount rule: Default
nodes.rationale: Month has no amount of its own and looks back to the latest Override default in an earlier month; unavailable when no earlier Override default exists, so there is always something to inherit.

nodes.label: Amount rule: Override default
nodes.rationale: Default amount applying from its month onward; look-back stops at the latest one reached. Changing a month away from it makes later months look further back.

nodes.label: Amount rule: Override one month
nodes.rationale: Amount for that month only; months looking back skip it so one-off changes do not leak forward.

frontmatter.name: remotion-to-hyperframes
frontmatter.description: Bring existing video code or footage into HyperFrames and verify it frame by frame against the original - Remotion first, also Motion Canvas, Lottie, Three.js, p5.js, canvas or plain HTML/CSS animation, or renders from Manim, After Effects or Blender. Use to port, convert, migrate or reuse work made with another tool.

frontmatter.name: hyperframes
frontmatter.description: Read first to make, edit, animate or render any video with HyperFrames (HTML rendered to video), including launch films, explainers, music videos, charts, maps, vertical clips, title cards, captions and overlays. Holds the render contract, the work loop and what each kind of video needs.

frontmatter.name: hyperframes-cli
frontmatter.description: The HyperFrames CLI by job - scaffold, check, look at frames, edit the timeline, preview, render locally or in the cloud, publish, project history - plus reading its JSON and recovering from build or render failures.

frontmatter.name: media-use
frontmatter.description: Get or make any media for a HyperFrames video - music, sound effects, images, icons, logos, voiceover, avatar and generated video, transcripts, cutouts, colour grades and looks - with HeyGen or free local tools, and mix placed audio. Also for footage that looks dark, flat or dull, or should be stylized or hidden.
